import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final double EPS = 1e-9;
    static final double PI = Math.acos(-1.0);
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int INF = 2000000000;
    static final int MAXN = 210;
    static final int MAXM = 2 * MAXN * MAXN;
    static final int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};
    static final int SRC = MAXN - 2;
    static final int DST = MAXN - 1;

    static class FlowGraph {
        int[] dest = new int[MAXM];
        int[] flow = new int[MAXM];
        int[] capacity = new int[MAXM];
        int edgeCount = 0;

        List<Integer>[] adj = new List[MAXN];
        boolean[] visited = new boolean[MAXN];

        FlowGraph() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
            dest[edgeCount] = v;
            flow[edgeCount] = 0;
            capacity[edgeCount] = cap;
            adj[u].add(edgeCount++);
            
            dest[edgeCount] = u;
            flow[edgeCount] = 0;
            capacity[edgeCount] = 0;
            adj[v].add(edgeCount++);
        }

        boolean findPath(int node, int target, int amount) {
            if (node == target) return true;
            visited[node] = true;

            for (int idx : adj[node]) {
                if (!visited[dest[idx]] && capacity[idx] - flow[idx] >= amount &&
                    findPath(dest[idx], target, amount)) {
                    flow[idx] += amount;
                    flow[idx ^ 1] -= amount;
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        int compute(int source, int sink) {
            int amount = 1 << 30;
            int total = 0;

            while (amount > 0) {
                if (findPath(source, sink, amount)) {
                    total += amount;
                } else {
                    amount >>= 1;
                }
                Arrays.fill(visited, false);
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    static FlowGraph graph = new FlowGraph();
    static int n, t;
    static char[][] A = new char[15][15];
    static char[][] B = new char[15][15];
    static int[][] dist = new int[15][15];
    static boolean[][] used = new boolean[15][15];

    static boolean safe(int x, int y) {
        return 0 <= x && x < n &&
               0 <= y && y < n &&
               A[x][y] != 'Y' &&
               A[x][y] != 'Z';
    }

    static void bfsFromZ(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                dist[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }

        Queue<Integer> qx = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qy = new LinkedList<>();
        dist[sx][sy] = 0;
        qx.add(sx);
        qy.add(sy);

        while (!qx.isEmpty()) {
            assert !qy.isEmpty();
            int cx = qx.poll();
            int cy = qy.poll();

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = cx + dx[k];
                int ny = cy + dy[k];
                if (safe(nx, ny) && dist[nx][ny] == INF) {
                    dist[nx][ny] = dist[cx][cy] + 1;
                    qx.add(nx);
                    qy.add(ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfsFromSource(int sx, int sy) {
        Queue<Integer> qx = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qy = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qlev = new LinkedList<>();
        Arrays.fill(used[0], false);
        for (int i = 1; i < 15; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(used[0], 0, used[i], 0, 15);
        }

        used[sx][sy] = true;
        qx.add(sx);
        qy.add(sy);
        qlev.add(0);

        while (!qx.isEmpty()) {
            assert !qy.isEmpty();
            int cx = qx.poll();
            int cy = qy.poll();
            int lev = qlev.poll();

            if (Character.isDigit(B[cx][cy]) && B[cx][cy] != '0') {
                graph.addEdge(sx * n + sy, n * n + 1 + cx * n + cy, INF);
            }

            if (lev >= t) continue;

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = cx + dx[k];
                int ny = cy + dy[k];

                if (safe(nx, ny) && !used[nx][ny]) {
                    if (dist[nx][ny] > lev + 1) {
                        qx.add(nx);
                        qy.add(ny);
                        qlev.add(lev + 1);
                    } else if (dist[nx][ny] > lev && Character.isDigit(B[nx][ny]) && B[nx][ny] != '0') {
                        graph.addEdge(sx * n + sy, n * n + 1 + nx * n + ny, INF);
                    }
                    used[nx][ny] = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void construct() {
        int sx = -1, sy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n && sx == -1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n && sx == -1; j++) {
                if (A[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sx = i;
                    sy = j;
                }
            }
        }

        bfsFromZ(sx, sy);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(A[i][j]) && A[i][j] != '0') {
                    graph.addEdge(SRC, i * n + j, A[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(B[i][j]) && B[i][j] != '0') {
                    graph.addEdge(i * n + j + n * n + 1, DST, B[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(A[i][j]) && A[i][j] != '0') {
                    bfsFromSource(i, j);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        t = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        
        br.readLine(); // skip empty line
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            A[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }
        
        br.readLine(); // skip empty line
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            B[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }

        construct();
        System.out.println(graph.compute(SRC, DST));
    }
}
